How much context is too much when a single 400k prompt can eat 10% of your weekly LLM budget in seconds?

As developers, we are constantly balancing context window sizes against API costs and rate limits. This week's updates show how fast the tooling and infrastructure are shifting.

Here is what is happening in the engineering space today:

⚠️ Anthropic users are reporting hitting session limits almost instantly when running Fable 5 on High. One developer on a Max plan saw their weekly usage jump from 4% to 14% after a single UI-edit prompt with a 400k context window.

💻 Claude Desktop now supports Ollama. You can configure the desktop app to use Ollama as a third-party gateway provider, making it possible to run open models directly within the Claude interface.

🛠️ OpenAI launched a new Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex. This tool allows team admins to analyze workspace usage, manage member permissions, adjust user limits, and act on admin requests.

🎙️ Google added intelligent dictation to Gemini for macOS. The feature runs desktop-wide, letting you speak naturally to input text into any active window on your machine.

With open models now running inside Claude Desktop and context costs spiking on proprietary models, the line between local and cloud workflows is blurring.

Are you planning to migrate some of your Claude workflows to local open models using Ollama?
